title: Linux Deck Profile Schema
description: Schema defining Macro Deck profiles, pages, grid dimensions (rows x cols), buttons, and telemetry widgets.

profile_id.description: Unique identifier for the Deck profile.

rows.description: Default number of grid rows per page.

cols.description: Default number of grid columns per page.

pages.description: Ordered list of pages (or folders) in this Deck profile.

buttonType.description: Functional category of the Deck button or widget.

page_id.description: Unique identifier of the page or target folder.

is_folder.description: Indicates if this page is a nested folder opened via a FOLDER button.

buttons.description: List of buttons and widgets positioned on this page's grid.

button_id.description: Unique identifier for the button within the profile.

row_span.description: Number of rows occupied by this button/widget.

col_span.description: Number of columns occupied by this button/widget.

title.description: Display label rendered on the button.

color.description: Hex color code (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for the button background.

active_icon.description: Icon identifier or name when the button is in active/running state.

inactive_icon.description: Icon identifier or name when the button is in idle/inactive state.

command.description: Shell command executed when type is COMMAND.

env.description: Environment variables injected into COMMAND execution.

timeout_seconds.description: Execution timeout in seconds for COMMAND buttons.

poll_command.description: Optional status polling command for toggle/status buttons.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Polling interval in seconds for dynamic button state.

key_combo.description: Shortcut expression (e.g. 'SUPER+SHIFT+Q', 'CTRL+ALT+T') when type is KEY_COMBO.

media_action.description: MPRIS2/Audio action triggered when type is MEDIA.

telemetry_metric.description: Metric displayed when type is TELEMETRY_WIDGET.

target_folder_id.description: Target page_id to navigate to when type is FOLDER.
